name: homedash
description: A single-user dashboard for a Proxmox homelab. Start, stop and reboot guests, see host and guest metrics, browse nginx sites, embed Grafana and watch Uptime Kuma, from the browser or a phone. Exposes a Prometheus /metrics endpoint for Grafana.

app_vars.name: var_homedash_admin_password
app_vars.label: Admin password (min 12 characters, random if empty)

app_vars.name: var_homedash_pve_node
app_vars.label: Proxmox node name
app_vars.help: Defaults to the hostname of the Proxmox host running the script

app_vars.name: var_homedash_grafana_url
app_vars.label: Grafana URL
app_vars.help: Optional. Lets homedash browse and embed Grafana dashboards

notes.text: The admin password is printed once at the end of the install. Reset it with: cd /opt/homedash/server && npm run create-user -- admin
Create the Proxmox API token with the PVEAuditor and PVEVMUser roles. Settings live in /opt/homedash/server/.env; run systemctl restart homedash after editing.
Runs over plain HTTP with COOKIE_SECURE=false. Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy set COOKIE_SECURE=true and TRUST_PROXY=true.
